Problem: James decides to sell 80% of his toys. He bought them for $20 each and sells them for $30 each. He had 200 toys. How much more money did he have compared to before he bought them?

- He sells 80% of 200 = 160 toys at $30 each, receiving 160 × $30 = $4800.
- Compared to before he bought them: he spent $4000, then received $4800. Net change: $4800 - $4000 = +$800.
- So he has $800 more than before he bought them.
